steps.check: 以三位元相位重複碼說明主導錯誤壓低後，稀有未保護通道仍可能主導。 圖中需標出量子態、控制訊號、經典資料與未觀測量。
steps.checkEn: Use a three-qubit phase repetition code to show how rare unprotected errors can dominate after suppression. Distinguish quantum states, controls, classical records and unobserved quantities.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 量子錯誤更正碼的效能取決於指定雜訊與校驗模型。
knowledge.textEn: Quantum-code performance depends on the specified noise and check model.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 以三位元相位重複碼說明主導錯誤壓低後，稀有未保護通道仍可能主導。
knowledge.textEn: Use a three-qubit phase repetition code to show how rare unprotected errors can dominate after suppression.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學聯集上界B=3pZ²(1−pZ)+pZ³+3pX；前項是完美多數決，後項界定任一X錯誤，忽略Y且不宣稱精確總率。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching boundB=3pZ²(1−pZ)+pZ³+3pX combines ideal phase majority failure and any-X union bound, ignoringY and not claiming an exact total.

stages.title: 噪聲與碼的配對
stages.description: 用X基底重複碼圖標可更正Z與未保護X，為兩種通道各列注入試驗。 依案例來源只註記可查證的裝置／方法；另以虛線標出本課新增的簡化假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Draw theX-basis repetition code, marking correctedZ and unprotectedX channels, with separate injection tests. Use the source only to label documented devices or methods; mark this exercise's simplifying assumptions with dashed connections.
